task.title: Later: share league data between visitors from the same league
task.description:
## Why
With everything in the browser, each visitor pulls a league's history themselves, even when a leaguemate already has. A shared cache would make every visit after the first one fast, and would allow report links that work for other people. Not needed for launch.

## Steps
1. Measure how often visitors from the same league appear, and how long first loads take in practice.
2. Design a small shared store for league seasons. Completed seasons never change, so they can be kept indefinitely.
3. Decide how data gets in: visitors' browsers upload what they fetched, or a small backend fetches on request. A backend that fetches shares one Sleeper rate limit across all visitors.
4. Add a way to check stored data is genuine before another visitor's report relies on it.
5. Consider storing finished reports so a link can be shared.

## Done when
- A design is agreed and split into stories, or the idea is dropped with the reason recorded here.
